text: Hi, Jack!
Elise... from math class.
Oh, of course. How are you, Denise?
Actually, it's Elise. E-L-I-S-E.
Oh, Elise. Sorry about that.
Hey, Sarah! How are you?
Oh, hi,.... I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name.
It's Mick.
Oh, that's right. Nick.
Actually it's Mick, with an M. M-I-C-K.
Mick. Got it. So, Mick, are you going to the gym this weekend?
Mike! Hello!
Oh, hello, uhhh...
Hannah. We met at Ellie's party.
Oh, right! How are you doing, Anna?
Pretty good! Actually my name's Hannah, not Anna-H-A-N-N-A-H.
Excuse me... don't I know you from somewhere?
1 think so... you look familiar... do you go to Eastern University?
No, I don't.... wait a minute, don't we wait at the same bus stop every morning?
Oh, that's right! But I'm always too tired to talk... My name's Stacy, by the way.
Hi, Stacy. I'm Devon.
Nice to meet you, Evan.
Oh, actually it's Devon. D-E-V-O-N.
Excuse me, aren't you Beth Fileo's son Mike, right?
Yes, I am. Actually it's Ike... no M, just I-K-E.
Oh, Ike. Sorry about that. I'm Liz Jones. I work with your mother.
Oh, of course. Good to see you again, Ms. Jones.
Hi, Tony. How are you?
Oh, I'm fine thank you. I'm sorry, I should know your name...
Tandy. I work in the accounting department.
Oh, that's right. How've you been, Mandy?
Actually, it's Tandy-T-A-N-D-Y. It's an unusual name, I know!
